description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPlayerClientBackend class, using Google Test framework. It tests creation, source attachment/removal, playback controls, seeking, volume/mute controls, and other media pipeline interactions.

classes.name: MediaPlayerClientBackend
classes.description: A class representing the media player backend, responsible for managing media pipeline interactions and playback controls.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerBackend
methods.description: Creates and initializes the media player backend with the provided media pipeline client and video requirements.

methods.name: isMediaPlayerBackendCreated
methods.description: Checks if the media player backend has been successfully created.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the media pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the media pipeline by its ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all media sources are attached.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specific type, mime type, and URL into the pipeline.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Checks if the media pipeline has data of a certain status.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate of the media.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the video window.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to the pipeline.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a video frame.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the media volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current media volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Sets the mute state.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Retrieves the mute state.
